2024-03-21 | #005  

Partly phase out of the DMA actuators for motorised butterfly & linear valves

Background

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-005_Partly-Phase-Out-DMA-Series_1R0_1. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. Since we introduced the Flow Control Drive (FCD) actuators, meanwhile we have also expanded this portfolio with actuators that have extended rotation time ranges. In combination with the various versions of Flow Control Valves (FCV…) users have the opportunity to substitute most of the former DMA/ DMK motorised butterfly & linear valves in new applications.

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-005_Partly-Phase-Out-DMA-Series_1R0_1. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. That's why we have decided to phase out most of the DMA actuators by the end of 2024. The DMA actuators for the NA market (USA/CDN) will continue without any impact.

With the release of this document, all relevant DMA units will be set to phase-out status. Customer orders for last time buy will be accepted until mid of 2024.

i |

Affected products and replacement options

Dieser Text ist für Produt: 2024-005_Partly-Phase-Out-DMA-Series_1R0_1. Produkt ID: RepNews. Der Dokumentyp is RepNews. The table below provides an overview of the DMA actuators that will be discontinued. It also provides a reference to an FCD actuator that may be a potential replacement.

For more information on technical details and comparisons, please visit the DUNGS website.

Replacement of a DMA actuator

On our website we also provide various adapter sets that allows to link a FCD actuator to a DMK motorized butterfly or linear valve.

Next Steps

Please inform your customers about the discontinuation of the DMA actuatsor and offer them the last time buy option or even promote them the new FCD Flow Control actuators in combination with the various versions of the Flow Control Valve series.
